discoveries.name: Maestro
discoveries.description: Cross-platform E2E testing framework for iOS, Android, and web apps. Visual IDE (Maestro Studio Desktop) with element inspector, action recording, and MaestroGPT AI assistant. OSS CLI + free Studio; paid cloud for parallel execution. Used by Microsoft, Meta, Uber, Amazon, Disney, Stripe.
